name: Fel Moss
summary: Fel Moss spreads through Teldrassil’s forests, its insidious corruptive energies carried by hostile grell and grellkin. The taint threatens the World Tree’s wildlife and native furbolg tribes.

sections.title: Blight on the World Tree
sections.body: Corruption has reached Teldrassil’s boughs, though the World Tree was planted to restore the night elves’ immortality and heal the natural world. Fel Moss is one clear sign of that decay. Impish grell and grellkin infest Shadowglen, with the unnatural, wicked magic of the moss clinging to them and radiating from their growth. The dryad Tarindrella gathers samples to measure how deeply the rot has entered the sacred woodland canopy.

sections.title: Seeds of Madness
sections.body: The furbolgs native to Teldrassil’s heights have succumbed to Fel Moss’s touch. Once peaceful, they abandoned their traditional dwellings and banded together as the hostile Gnarlpine tribe. The moss’s evil power drives them mad under leaders such as Ursal the Mauler, revealing a sickness taking root within the great tree.

faq.answer: Fel Moss is corrupted plant matter found in Teldrassil. Its insidious, foul energies cling to grell and grellkin and threaten the surrounding wildlife and native furbolgs.

faq.q: Where does Fel Moss come from?
aliases: where do you get fel moss
faq.answer: Around Shadowglen, grell and grellkin carry clumps of Fel Moss through Teldrassil’s hills. The moss bears corruptive energies spreading through the World Tree’s forests.

faq.q: How does Fel Moss affect the furbolgs?
faq.answer: Fel Moss’s evil power has touched the furbolgs native to Teldrassil. They abandoned their traditional dwellings and formed the hostile, xenophobic Gnarlpine tribe, driven mad under leaders like Ursal the Mauler.

faq.q: Who is trying to stop the spread of Fel Moss?
faq.answer: In Shadowglen, the dryad Tarindrella gathers Fel Moss samples from grellkin to measure how deeply corruption has spread through the woodland. She directs concerned protectors to druids such as Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar.

angles.text: As a druid of the Cenarion Circle, you see Fel Moss as a cancer spreading through Teldrassil. Its demonic blight shows how vulnerable the newborn World Tree is.
As a night elf, you venerate Teldrassil as your new homeland. Fel Moss is a distressing omen that peace remains elusive among its sacred boughs.
